rulings.raw: 1/4 cup loosely packed fresh sage leaves
rulings.evidence: REUSE of the live fresh-sage id (2 of 7, cheapest 4.98 at Baker's). No bridge to ground sage: dried leaf is a different price class and a different gram weight, exactly as the fresh-thyme and fresh-rosemary rulings held.

rulings.raw: 2 lemons (, zest only (avoid grating the pith which is bitter))
rulings.evidence: REUSE of the live lemons id (5 of 7, cheapest 0.4533 at Walmart); zest is the peel of the fruit you buy, per the 2026-08-26 'lemon zest' ruling. 2 medium lemons at 58 g.
